epic.name: Door-2 get_transcript Rung
decisions: Door 2 (youtubei/v1/get_transcript) is the primary rung; timedtext rungs (api, yt-dlp) are kept for the clean-IP case.
ASYMMETRIC per-door gating: a Door-1 (timedtext) block cools Door-1 ONLY so Door-2 stays reachable; a Door-2 (innertube) block arms the SHARED cooldown across all doors. Min-spacing stays global.
record_outcome must be door-aware on SUCCESS: a Door-2 success must never clear a cooldown armed by Door-1. Calls with door=None keep today's behavior exactly (backward compatible).

The gate moves from ONE pre-loop check to PER-RUNG checks. A blocked door SKIPS that rung and continues down the ladder instead of aborting the whole fetch -- this is what makes Door-2 reachable while Door-1 cools.
params protobuf uses DYNAMIC length-prefixing. kkdai/youtube's hardcoded lengths are a known landmine that silently corrupts multi-byte codes like en-US / zh-Hans / pt-BR.
Hand-roll varint encoding (~15 lines). Do NOT add a protobuf dependency -- it is not installed anywhere in the venv.

Block detection is substring matching on stringified exceptions (ratelimit BLOCK_MARKERS). Door-2 returns HTTP status codes, so it MUST raise a marker-matching detail string or the cooldown silently never arms.
The CDP rung is opt-in behind CINOPSIS_ENABLE_CDP (default OFF). Cowork has no Bash tool, so it can never run there and must degrade rather than try to launch a browser.
mcp_server.py:184 currently calls get_transcript_ytdlp directly, bypassing cache + ladder + gate. Repoint it at fetch_transcript.
references: Invidious transcript.cr -- https://github.com/iv-org/invidious/blob/master/src/invidious/videos/transcript.cr (params DSL + response path, primary source)
kkdai/youtube transcript.go -- https://github.com/kkdai/youtube/blob/master/transcript.go (independent Go impl, byte-literal, cross-validates field numbers)
invidious#5387 -- https://github.com/iv-org/invidious/issues/5387 (LIVE bug: some segment renderers omit 'snippet')
scripts/export_yt_cookies.py:76-112 (existing CDP launch + websocket pattern to mirror)
outOfScope: ABSOLUTE: no network calls to youtube.com from ANY story. All tests are network-free with HTTP monkeypatched. The single live probe is MANUAL, human-gated, and deliberately not a story.
No proxy, no paid transcript API, no PO-token minting.
Do not remove the api / yt-dlp / asr rungs -- they work on a clean egress.
Do not add a protobuf dependency.
Do not refactor the ladder into a registry -- the dispatch tuple stays a tuple, minimal diff.
No bulk fetching or loops anywhere, in any test or script.
risks: The residential IP is ALREADY FLAGGED and the gate is currently armed. Any accidental live fetch deepens the block. Treat youtube.com as untouchable during implementation.
?key= is unresolved: Invidious POSTs keyless, kkdai appends the WEB key. Implement keyless-first with a keyed retry rather than guessing.
find_chrome() raises SystemExit (a BaseException) -- it will NOT be caught by the ladder's 'except Exception' and would tear down the whole fetch if unwrapped.
websocket-client is venv-only (hand-installed, REQUESTED marker). The venv bootstrap hashes requirements.txt, so a clean install would ImportError on the CDP rung.
Changing the gate from one pre-loop call to per-rung calls risks double-counting min-spacing sleeps across 5 rungs -- spacing must not multiply per rung.

stories.title: Add protobuf params builder for the get_transcript endpoint
stories.description: Pure, network-free functions that encode the nested protobuf 'params' field: varint, length-delimited tag helper, and build_transcript_params(video_id, lang, auto_generated) -> urlsafe base64 string.

steps.description: Add _varint(n) -> bytes implementing standard protobuf base-128 varint encoding.
Add _len_delim(field_no, payload) -> bytes emitting tag ((field_no<<3)|2) + varint(len) + payload.

Add build_transcript_params(video_id, language_code='en', auto_generated=True): inner message = field1 kind ('asr' or ''), field2 language_code, field3 empty string; base64-urlsafe the inner bytes to a STRING; outer message = field1 videoId, field2 that base64 string, field3 varint 1; return base64-urlsafe of outer.
Use DYNAMIC length prefixes everywhere. Never hardcode byte lengths -- verify by encoding 'zh-Hans' and 'en-US' and confirming the length bytes match len(code).
Add DOOR_TIMEDTEXT = 'timedtext' and DOOR_INNERTUBE = 'innertube' module constants.

context.why: The params field is the only non-obvious part of Door 2; two independent production implementations (Invidious, kkdai) confirm the exact field numbers and the inner-base64-as-string double encoding.
risks: kkdai hardcodes length prefixes and silently corrupts multi-byte language codes -- do not copy that shortcut.

stories.title: Add asymmetric per-door gating to ratelimit.py
stories.description: Extend check_gate and record_outcome with an optional door dimension so a Door-1 block cannot lock out Door-2, while a Door-2 block still arms the shared cooldown. Fully backward compatible when door is omitted.

steps.description: Change signatures to check_gate(source='fetch', door=None) and record_outcome(ok, detail='', door=None).
Add a 'doors' sub-dict to the state file holding per-door block_until / fail_streak. _load() must tolerate the existing flat schema with no migration (missing keys read as absent).
check_gate: raise RateLimited only if THAT door is blocked (or if the shared block is armed). Keep min-spacing GLOBAL and ensure it is applied once per call, never multiplied per rung.

record_outcome on block: if door == 'innertube' (Door 2), arm the SHARED cooldown across all doors; otherwise arm only that door's cooldown. Preserve exponential backoff BASE * 2**(streak-1) capped at MAX.
record_outcome on success: clear the cooldown only when the stored block_door is None or equals the passed door. A Door-2 success must NOT clear a Door-1-armed cooldown.
When door is None, behavior must be byte-for-byte identical to today so fetch_playlist / fetch_videos / capture_frames are unaffected.

context.why: check_gate fires once before the whole ladder, so without a door dimension a Door-1 IpBlocked would lock out Door-2 -- the exact door proven to still work -- defeating the entire feature.
risks: Moving to per-rung gating could multiply the min-spacing sleep across 5 rungs.
Existing callers must not change behavior.
edgeCases: Old flat state file with no 'doors' key
Corrupt state file (must still fail closed)

stories.title: Add ytcfg scrape with TTL cache
stories.description: Scrape INNERTUBE clientVersion (and visitor_data if present) once from the watch page, cached to disk with a TTL, with a pinned fallback so a scrape failure never blocks the rung.

steps.description: Add _scrape_ytcfg() that regex-extracts INNERTUBE_CLIENT_VERSION and VISITOR_DATA from a watch-page HTML string.
Cache the result to DATA_DIR / 'ytcfg_cache.json' with a timestamp and TTL so the watch-page GET happens once, not per video. Never a hardcoded path.
Fall back to a pinned clientVersion constant when scraping fails or the cache is cold and the network is unavailable.
Keep the HTTP fetch itself in a small separate injectable function so tests can monkeypatch it with zero network.

context.why: Invidious's working implementation sends clientName/clientVersion headers; scraping keeps them fresh, while the pinned fallback keeps the rung usable offline or when the page shape changes.
risks: The watch-page GET is itself a request to youtube.com and must be counted by the gate and cached aggressively.
edgeCases: visitor_data absent (Invidious does not send it)

stories.title: Implement get_transcript_innertube rung and response parser
stories.description: POST to youtubei/v1/get_transcript, parse transcript segments into the ladder's exact normalized shape, and raise block-marker-matching errors so the gate arms correctly.

steps.description: Add get_transcript_innertube(video_id) -> (transcript, lang) matching the signature contract of every other rung.

POST https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/get_transcript?prettyPrint=false with headers content-type application/json; charset=UTF-8, x-goog-api-format-version: 2, x-youtube-client-name, x-youtube-client-version, and a browser User-Agent. Body: {'context': {'client': {hl, gl, clientName, clientVersion}}, 'params': <built params>}.
Try keyless first (Invidious style); on a 400/403 that indicates a missing key, retry once with the WEB client key appended (kkdai style). Do not guess -- implement both paths.
Try kind='asr' first, then manual kind='' -- auto-captions are the common case.
Parse actions[0].updateEngagementPanelAction.content.transcriptRenderer.content.transcriptSearchPanelRenderer.body.transcriptSegmentListRenderer.initialSegments[].
Use SAFE access for 'snippet' (invidious#5387 -- it is sometimes absent) and skip transcriptSectionHeaderRenderer heading entries.
startMs arrives as a JSON STRING in milliseconds -- convert with float(int(startMs)) / 1000.0. Emit exactly [{'start': float_seconds, 'text': str}] with no 'duration' key, matching the api/asr rungs.

On HTTP 429/403 or a block-shaped body, raise an exception whose stringified form contains a ratelimit BLOCK_MARKERS substring (e.g. 'IpBlocked' or 'HTTP Error 429') so record_outcome actually arms the cooldown.
Use the requests library (already declared in requirements.txt). Make the HTTP call injectable so tests can monkeypatch it with zero network.

context.why: Door 2 is the un-throttled endpoint; timedtext (api + yt-dlp on every client + TLS impersonation) all 429 on this IP while get_transcript returned 474 segments.
risks: Door-2 returns HTTP codes, not typed exceptions, so the gate will silently never arm unless the error string is marker-matching.
?key= requirement is unresolved between the two reference implementations.
edgeCases: video with no transcript panel at all

stories.title: Create grab_transcript_cdp.py windowed CDP panel fallback
stories.description: Promote the proven CDP transcript-panel grabber to a script, reusing the existing dedicated-profile pattern, guarded so it can never crash the ladder or fire in a headless/Cowork context.

steps.description: Import PROFILE_DIR and find_chrome from export_yt_cookies (already portable: canonical_data_dir()/'yt-profile', env-driven).
WRAP find_chrome() in try/except SystemExit and return None -- SystemExit is a BaseException and would otherwise tear down the entire ladder past 'except Exception'.

Launch Chrome WINDOWED (not headless -- headless does not render the transcript panel) with --remote-debugging-port, --user-data-dir=PROFILE_DIR, --remote-allow-origins=*, --no-first-run, --no-default-browser-check.
Discover the debug endpoint by polling http://127.0.0.1:<port>/json/version, mirroring export_yt_cookies.py:89-99. Use the websocket-client library as that file already does.
Navigate to the watch page, click #expand, then click button[aria-label='Show transcript'], then read ytd-transcript-segment-renderer segments.
Expose grab(video_id) -> text per the contract, plus get_transcript_cdp(video_id) -> (list[{start,text}], lang) adapting to the ladder shape.
Guard the whole rung behind CINOPSIS_ENABLE_CDP (default OFF) so headless / Cowork / CI runs never try to open a browser window.
Clean up in a finally block: terminate() -> wait(timeout=10) -> kill(), matching export_yt_cookies.py:159-161.
Add websocket-client to requirements.txt -- it is currently venv-only (hand-installed) and a clean install would ImportError.

context.why: The browser panel is the only path proven to work on this flagged IP (474 segments) and is the guaranteed fallback if the pure-HTTP Door-2 call ever needs a PO token.
risks: find_chrome() SystemExit escaping the ladder.
Opening a browser window in a headless or Cowork context.
websocket-client missing on a clean install.

stories.title: Wire both new rungs and per-rung gating into the ladder
stories.description: Insert innertube as rung 1 and cdp-panel as the final rung, and move gating from one pre-loop call to per-rung checks so a blocked door skips its rung instead of aborting the fetch.

steps.description: Extend the dispatch tuple to (innertube, api, yt-dlp, asr, cdp-panel) in that exact order, keeping it a literal tuple -- do not refactor into a registry.
Map each rung to its door: innertube and cdp-panel -> DOOR_INNERTUBE; api and yt-dlp -> DOOR_TIMEDTEXT; asr -> None (no YouTube transcript door).
Replace the single pre-loop check_gate at :225 with a per-rung check_gate(source, door=rung_door) inside the loop.
On RateLimited for a rung, print the gate message, SKIP that rung, and CONTINUE to the next -- do not abort the ladder. This is what makes Door-2 reachable while Door-1 cools.
Call record_outcome(ok, detail, door=rung_door) per rung so each door's state is tracked independently.
If every rung was gate-skipped (none actually ran), preserve the existing (None, None, 'rate-limited') return contract.
Keep the cache rung ungated and ahead of everything -- it performs no network I/O.
Ensure global min-spacing is not multiplied across the 5 rungs.

context.why: Gating per rung rather than per fetch is the change that lets a flagged Door 1 cool down while Door 2 keeps serving transcripts.
risks: Aborting instead of skipping would reintroduce the exact bug this feature exists to fix.
min-spacing multiplication across rungs.
edgeCases: cache hit short-circuits before any gate

stories.title: Close the mcp_server.py gate bypass
stories.description: Repoint the MCP get_transcript tool from the direct get_transcript_ytdlp call to fetch_transcript so it gets cache, Door-2, and full gating.

steps.description: Replace the direct get_transcript_ytdlp(...) call at mcp_server.py:184 with fetch_transcript(...).
Adapt for the 3-tuple return (transcript, lang, method) instead of the rung's 2-tuple.
Preserve the existing integrity_gate banner behavior at mcp_server.py:190.
Confirm no direct rung call remains: grep for get_transcript_ytdlp in mcp_server.py must return nothing.

context.why: This is a live un-gated hole into YouTube from the MCP surface; 'no rung bypasses the gate' is not true until it is closed.
risks: Return-shape mismatch: the rung returns 2 values, the dispatcher returns 3.

stories.title: Test params encoding including the multi-byte language landmine
stories.description: Network-free unit tests locking the protobuf params encoding, including the dynamic-length cases that kkdai's implementation gets wrong.

steps.description: Add the house sys.path bootstrap to scripts/ (see tests/test_playlist_pacing.py:13-14) -- there is no conftest.py in this repo.
test_params_encoding_golden: a known video_id + 'en' + asr encodes to an exact expected base64 string.
test_params_dynamic_lengths: 'zh-Hans' and 'en-US' produce length prefixes equal to len(code) -- the kkdai landmine.
test_params_kind_manual_vs_asr: auto_generated True vs False produce different, correctly-shaped payloads.
Decode the produced bytes back and assert field numbers and wire types, so the test documents the format rather than just pinning a magic string.

context.why: params encoding is the single highest-risk piece of Door 2 and is fully testable offline.
risks: A golden string alone would pin a wrong encoding; round-trip decoding guards against that.

stories.title: Test the three door-gating guarantees
stories.description: Lock the asymmetric gating semantics that make the feature work and keep the flagged IP protected.

steps.description: test_gate_door1_block_leaves_door2_open: after a Door-1 IpBlocked, check_gate(door='innertube') must NOT raise.
test_gate_door2_block_arms_shared: after a Door-2 IpBlocked, BOTH doors must be blocked.
test_gate_door2_success_preserves_door1_cooldown: a Door-2 success must leave a Door-1-armed cooldown intact.
test_gate_backward_compat_no_door: record_outcome(ok, detail) with no door behaves exactly as before.
test_gate_tolerates_legacy_state: an old flat state file with no 'doors' key loads without error.
Redirect state to tmp_path via CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA / monkeypatched DATA_DIR so the real gate file is never touched.

context.why: These three assertions ARE the feature: without them Door 2 is unreachable, or the flagged IP loses its protection.
risks: Touching the real fetch_ratelimit.json during tests would corrupt live gate state.

stories.title: Test ladder order, response parsing, and CDP safety
stories.description: Verify Door-2 is tried first, the parser handles the known schema edge cases, and the CDP rung cannot kill the ladder.

steps.description: test_ladder_order_innertube_first: innertube appears before api in the dispatch order.
test_parse_cuegroups_shape: a fixture response JSON parses to [{'start': float, 'text': str}] with no 'duration' key and start in SECONDS.
test_parse_missing_snippet: a segment lacking 'snippet' is skipped without raising (invidious#5387).
test_parse_section_header_skipped: transcriptSectionHeaderRenderer entries are not emitted as transcript text.
test_blocked_door_skips_rung_not_ladder: with Door-1 blocked, the ladder still reaches and returns from the innertube rung.
test_cdp_missing_chrome_no_systemexit: a missing Chrome returns (None, None) and does NOT raise SystemExit.
Monkeypatch every HTTP call. Assert zero network: no test may resolve or connect to youtube.com.

context.why: These cover the three failure modes that would only otherwise surface as a live crash against a flagged IP.
risks: A test that accidentally performs a real fetch would deepen the IP block.

stories.title: Test the drip cap still bounds every batch
stories.description: Regression-lock the v2.5.0 anti-hammer pacing so the new rungs cannot be driven in a burst.

steps.description: test_drip_cap_never_exceeds_five: a request for more than 5 videos still fetches at most 5 (fetch_transcripts.py MAX_CHUNK).
Assert the THROTTLE_SEC gap is applied between fetches within a call but not before the first.
Monkeypatch fetch_transcript and time.sleep so the test is instant and network-free.

context.why: The staggered drip is a non-negotiable that predates this work; adding rungs must not weaken it.
risks: A regression here directly translates into IP hammering.

stories.title: Validate conformance and full suite
stories.description: Static and suite-level validation only. No live network probe -- that step is manual and human-gated.

steps.description: Run claude plugin validate . and confirm it passes clean.
ast.parse and import every touched script: get_transcript.py, ratelimit.py, grab_transcript_cdp.py, mcp_server.py, fetch_transcripts.py.
Run python -m pytest tests/ -q and confirm all tests pass -- the pre-change baseline was 57 passing, so the total must be 57 plus the new tests, with zero regressions.
Grep scripts/ for hardcoded paths (C:\\ or /Users/) and confirm none were introduced.
Confirm websocket-client is present in requirements.txt.
DO NOT perform any live YouTube fetch. Report ready-for-probe and stop.

context.why: Everything verifiable offline must be green before a single live request is spent against a flagged IP.
risks: An autonomous live probe would violate the hardest constraint in this project.
